description: Natural faults: authoring mistakes that actually occurred (and were fixed) during the drawer_opening construction session, re-injected verbatim as text replacements. element_uri names the specification element a perfect diagnosis should point at.

faults.name: n01_grasp_normal_axis_typo
faults.note: The grasp normal was first authored as the tool y axis; the pads close along x. Fingers clamped the drawer panel and the grasp jammed.

faults.name: n02_center_gate_too_wide
faults.note: The centered-grasp gate was tried at 3 mm; the bar cams out of pads that close a few mm off-center. 2 mm is the working value.

faults.name: n03_no_grasp_standoff
faults.note: The grasp was first authored directly on the bar plane with no standoff; fingertips dragged the drawer face during the close.

faults.name: n04_approach_integral_hangover
faults.note: The approach x controller was first authored with the same Ki as the gravity axis; the wound-up integral dragged the approach into a long stall.
faults.find: pid ctrl-a1-x { constraint: <approach1.at-handle-x>, Kp: 80, Ki: 0, Kd: 24, decay: 0 } via <arm1-solver>,
faults.replace: pid ctrl-a1-x { constraint: <approach1.at-handle-x>, Kp: 80, Ki: 80, Kd: 24, decay: 0 } via <arm1-solver>,
